description: This PHP source file defines a Drupal plugin class 'CreateForEachBundle' that creates configuration entities for each bundle of a specified entity type. It includes methods for instantiation, applying configuration changes with placeholder replacements, and handling placeholders recursively.

classes.name: CreateForEachBundle
classes.description: A final class implementing a Drupal plugin that creates configuration entities for each bundle of a specified entity type, with methods for creation, application, and placeholder replacement.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin, retrieving necessary services from the container and validating plugin definition.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies configuration changes by replacing placeholders in the provided value and invoking the create action for each bundle.

methods.name: replacePlaceholders
methods.description: Recursively replaces '%bundle' and '%label' placeholders in data structures.
